limitations: Host handler-to-present API timings exclude OS dispatch and physical display.
CUA mouse actions include AX observations between drags; this is not a physical mouse/pen benchmark.
Published counters exclude pending thread-local work, and capture endpoints may differ by a small number of boundary operations.
Source byte counters exclude cloned object/vector payloads, allocator overhead and unrelated GPU transfers.
Application defaults including recovery are retained; ordinary desktop background load is not isolated.
Copies-restored control changes copy placement only, not readiness/frame routing; it is not a different old release.

interpretation.latency: Trial-median pointer-up p95 is lower, but trial ranges overlap and folded-order A2 trial 1 is nearly equal to reduced trials. A consistent causal input-latency gain is not established.
interpretation.priority_next: Reduce host work in effect-enabled vector release previews; optimized preview p95 median 94.644 ms and render_encode host p95 median 91.832 ms. Durations are inclusive and must not be added or called GPU execution time.

capture_recipe.api: Native cua_repl App.drag and full getAXState after every drag; no DOM evaluation or synthetic shell input
capture_recipe.movement: Repeat forward/back pairs until each block has >=31,000 ms active automation time, always finish at original position. Two blocks per trial.
capture_recipe.validation: Every observation contains finite X/Y/W/H; forward X=10.583 mm, backward X=3.528 mm, W/H=28.222 mm.
capture_recipe.process_setup: Open same fixture, select Vector Layer 1, vector tool mode and vector selection; explicitly set 50%; six warmup drags.
capture_recipe.cleanup: Save while canvas owns focus, quit each process, assert all five fixture SHA256 values equal generation originals.

concurrent_workspace_note: At final review, dependency manifests/lockfiles and vendor sources had concurrent changes outside this task. They are preserved. Measurements use the single recorded executable hash; they are not a build/test claim for those later dependency changes. External background build activity is not established or excluded.
compiled_executable_validation: Release artifact used for all runs; own builds/tests finished before measurements. Source identities and runtime control behavior are recorded; later workspace dependency edits require their own build validation.
